basis: Every transfer draws from its declared source or a funded parent. Explicit root low/high scenarios prevent extra reservoir people. Zero natural growth; only declared net entries create people. Dated losses remove modeled Perire dead. Low/central/high are explicit visualization scenarios, not censuses or statistical confidence intervals. Source headcounts remain unknown. Campaign tallies, surviving migrants, households, genetic ancestry and resident populations are distinct counting units. Component allocations and survival factors are model choices.
